answer: Mechanism: Mesa-Pulse Operator Lease. Each operator registers one sable control key and a prepaid compute lease. Agent wallets can only spend action credits from that lease, and every wallet action must carry a signed pulse from the same key; sybil wallets therefore share one quota. If clustering links wallets to one pulse signer, the protocol revokes the lease, forfeits remaining compute, and puts the operator’s sable key on a mesa-wide deny list for N epochs. Attacker cost: lost prepaid compute plus infrastructure and key rotation, not wallet balances.
